label: Finite inhabited eligible exercise fibres at actual identity bearers
term: finite inhabited eligible exercise fibre at actual identity
definition: For each bearer r in act as to esse whose represented esse equals its represented essence, the fibre { e : E | bearer e = r } is finite and nonempty. E is the selected eligible exercise type and bearer is the fixed exercise-to-bearer map. There is no finiteness or habitation requirement at other bearers.
note: Analyst stipulation, attribution deferred. Exercise individuation and eligibility fix what is counted and remain OPEN for application. The only identity bearer has one eligible exercise in the three-token feedback control, whereas its fibre contains every even index in the alternating chain. Counting bearers, essence values or clock instants does not count exercise tokens. The universal condition does not assert that an actual identity bearer exists.
